rows.desc: K-Means assignment: nearest centroid (L2) per point. Paper: Flash-KMeans assign, B200.
Exact k-NN search; recall must be ~1.0 and indices unique. Paper: dispatcher portfolio.
Small-M GEMM  y = x @ w.T. Paper: TinyGEMM, 35 decode shapes.
Kimi Delta Attention single-step decode with per-channel decay (gated delta rule).
Kimi Delta Attention prefill over T tokens from cached state (sequential delta-rule oracle).

provenance: Hand-written example kernels in examples/ scored with `cakebench suite --device cuda --full` on one shared A100-SXM4-40GB, as recorded in this repo's README at commit 7631683. Timing is median GPU span with L2 flushed; shared box, so timings are noisy.
